answer: A farm running 124 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the wander stake is held until the oasis settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the forge audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 42% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
